A '''Chiss''' was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and was trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="FJ" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Note">''[[The Shadow Syndicate]]'' expansion set is set during the timeframe of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]].</ref> the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] attacked two Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], using the Force to [[Force jump/Legends|jump]] toward the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. The Chiss Jedi was [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned with red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. They used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss Jedi was depicted on the "Force Jump" card for ''[[The Shadow Syndicate]]'', an expansion set of cards for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'',<ref name="FJ" /> which released in [[2009]].<ref name="Game Date">{{SWArchive|url=games/videogames/news20090908/index.html|text=New TCG Expansion: The Shadow Syndicate}}</ref> They were illustrated by artist [[Sean Pando]].<ref name="Game Interface">[[Sony]] Online Entertainment interface for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''</ref>
